# mysuite command reference

<!-- generated by `mysuite schema --markdown`; do not edit by hand -->

## Global options

- `--allow` - Sandbox: only read/write inside this folder (repeatable). Also set by MYSUITE_ROOTS. A path outside is refused with exit code 3. Meant for agents.
- `--sandbox` - Sandbox: allow only the current folder (same as --allow .).

## Exit codes

- `0` - ok
- `1` - at least one item failed (or an unexpected error)
- `2` - bad usage (unknown option, missing argument) - not JSON, comes from the argument parser
- `3` - refused by the sandbox/policy - nothing was written
- `4` - a required external tool is missing - see missing_tools for install hints

## `mysuite compress`

Re-encode image(s) via a best-in-class codec (mozjpeg/webp/avif/oxipng/pngquant/gifsicle), with optional sharpening.

- argument `inputs` (path, repeatable) One or more files, and/or directories, to compress (non-recursive unless --recursive). Not needed with --list-presets.
- `--preset` (str) Named settings bundle (codec + its parameters) to start from — run --list-presets to see them. Any other flag you also pass overrides that field of the preset; --codec becomes optional when --preset is given.
- `--list-presets` (boolean) List available compress presets and exit.
- `--codec` (str) Target codec: mozjpeg, webp, avif, oxipng, pngquant, gifsicle. Required unless --preset supplies one.
- `--quality` (int range) Codec quality, 0-100 (mozjpeg/webp/avif only — ignored by oxipng/gifsicle, use --quality-range for pngquant).
- `--sharpen-amount` (float) Unsharp mask amount applied before encoding (e.g. 1.0). Unset = no sharpening.
- `--sharpen-radius` (float) Unsharp mask radius (default 2.0).
- `--sharpen-sigma` (float) Unsharp mask sigma / blur amount (default 1.0).
- `--sharpen-threshold` (float) Unsharp mask threshold — minimum brightness change to sharpen (default 0.0).
- `--progressive / --baseline` (boolean) [mozjpeg] Progressive vs. baseline JPEG encoding (default progressive).
- `--subsample` (str) [mozjpeg] Chroma subsampling: 4:4:4 or 4:2:0 (default 4:2:0).
- `--lossless / --lossy` (boolean) [webp] Lossless encoding instead of lossy (default lossy).
- `--method` (int range) [webp] Compression effort, 0-6, slower = smaller (default 6).
- `--alpha-quality` (int range) [webp] Alpha channel quality, 0-100 (default 100).
- `--speed` (int range) [avif] Encoder speed, 0-10, slower = smaller (default 6).
- `--effort` (int range) [oxipng] Optimization effort, 0-6 (default 4).
- `--interlace / --no-interlace` (boolean) [oxipng] Apply Adam7 interlacing (default off).
- `--quality-range` (str) [pngquant] min-max quality range, e.g. 65-90 (default 65-90).
- `--pngquant-speed` (int range) [pngquant] Speed/quality trade-off, 1 (slow) - 11 (fast) (default 4).
- `--dither / --no-dither` (boolean) [pngquant] Floyd-Steinberg dithering (default on).
- `--optimize-level` (int range) [gifsicle] Optimization level, 1-3 (default 3).
- `--lossy` (int range) [gifsicle] Lossy compression amount, 0-200 (default 0).
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories for folder inputs.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview input -> output pairs without compressing.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite convert`

Convert file(s) to another format, in place beside the source.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more files, and/or directories, to convert (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--to / -t` (str) Comma-separated target format(s), e.g. webp or png,pdf.
- `--quality` (int range) JPEG/WebP quality, 0-100.
- `--dpi / --ppi` (float, default `300`) Resolution used only when rasterizing a vector source (svg/pdf/eps); ignored for raster-to-raster conversions.
- `--background` (str) Flatten transparency onto a color (jpeg/bmp default to white if unset — they have no alpha channel).
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories for folder inputs.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview input -> output pairs without converting.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite cutout`

Isolate a photo's subject into a transparent-background PNG (macOS Vision).

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more image files, and/or directories, to cut out (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories for folder inputs.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview input -> output pairs without cutting out anything.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite doctor`

Check that required tools (rsvg-convert, gs, magick, mysuite-cutout, exiftool, c2patool, codec encoders) are installed.

- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite enhance history`

Show jobs recorded with --record-history.

- `--limit` (int range, default `50`) 
- `--clear` (boolean) Delete the history database.

## `mysuite enhance presets`

List enhance presets (built-in and from mysuite.toml).

- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.

## `mysuite enhance run`

Enhance photo(s), writing <name>_enhanced.<ext> beside each source.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more photos, and/or directories (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--preset` (str) Settings bundle to start from (see `mysuite enhance presets`). Any other flag you pass overrides that field. Default: gentle.
- `--scale` (int range) Upscale factor, 1-8.
- `--denoise` (float range) Denoise strength, 0-1.
- `--sharpen` (float range) Sharpen strength, 0-1.
- `--face-enhance / --no-face-enhance` (boolean) Face restoration (needs the optional AI backend).
- `--auto-white-balance / --no-auto-white-balance` (boolean) Gray-world white balance.
- `--saturation` (float range) 1.0 = unchanged.
- `--contrast` (float range) 1.0 = unchanged.
- `--gamma` (float range) 1.0 = unchanged, <1 brightens.
- `--restore-scratches / --no-restore-scratches` (boolean) Fill thin straight scratches/creases from their surroundings.
- `--format` (str) png, jpg or webp.
- `--quality` (int range) jpg/webp quality.
- `--backend` (str, default `auto`) auto, classical or realesrgan.
- `--record-history` (boolean) Log each job (paths, sizes, timing) to a local database for `enhance history`. Off by default: a log of what you processed is a trace.
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing outputs.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) List input -> output pairs, write nothing.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Print only the summary.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite export`

Batch-export an SVG into multiple sizes, formats, and color profiles.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more SVG files, and/or directories of SVGs (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--sizes / -s` (str) Comma-separated sizes: plain numbers are pixels, or suffix with mm/cm/in (e.g. 16,32,5cm,2in).
- `--formats / -f` (str) Comma-separated: png,pdf,eps,svg,jpeg,webp,tiff,ico,icns (ico/icns bundle multiple sizes into one file).
- `--profiles / -p` (str) Comma-separated: rgb,cmyk
- `--dpi / --ppi` (float) Pixels/dots per inch used to convert mm/cm/in sizes to pixels (default from config, usually 300).
- `--unit` (str) Default unit (px, mm, cm, or in) for sizes with no explicit suffix, e.g. --unit mm --sizes 50,80 means 50mm,80mm. Per-size suffixes still override this.
- `--background` (str) Background color (e.g. white, #ffffff) to flatten onto for formats without transparency. JPEG defaults to white if unset; other formats stay transparent.
- `--quality` (int range) JPEG/WebP compression quality (0-100).
- `--padding / --margin` (str) Uniform safe-space margin around the artwork for raster formats, e.g. 20, 20px, or 10%% of each size. No background color is forced — it stays transparent unless --background is also set. Vector formats (pdf/eps/svg) are unaffected. Overridden per side by --margin-top/-right/-bottom/-left.
- `--margin-top` (str) Top margin, overrides --margin for this side.
- `--margin-right` (str) Right margin, overrides --margin for this side.
- `--margin-bottom` (str) Bottom margin, overrides --margin for this side.
- `--margin-left` (str) Left margin, overrides --margin for this side.
- `--png-compression` (int range) PNG zlib compression level (0-9). Lossless either way — trades encode time for file size.
- `--out / -o` (path) Base output directory.
- `--name` (str) Override base name (default: each input file's stem). Only valid with a single input.
- `--date-stamp / --no-date-stamp` (boolean) Insert today's date (YYYYMMDD) into filenames, e.g. logo_512_20260819.png. Only applies to the tool's own default naming templates — a naming_template you've already customized is left alone (it can reference {date} itself instead).
- `--variant` (str) Label this run as a variant (e.g. negative, mono) — nests output under exports/<name>/<variant>/... alongside the primary exports/<name>/... export instead of getting its own top-level name folder.
- `--recolor` (str, repeatable) Color substitution FROM=TO — hex (e.g. --recolor '#000000=#ffffff') or a named CSS color (e.g. --recolor 'white=black'). Repeatable, and each occurrence may itself hold several space/comma-separated pairs, e.g. --recolor '#000=#fff white=black'. Applied to the SVG source before rendering.
- `--recolor-tolerance` (float range, default `2.0`) How close (CIEDE2000 colour difference) a colour must be to a --recolor FROM to count as it; 0 = exact match only, 2 = just-noticeable difference (default). Catches anti-aliased or slightly-off brand colours.
- `--cmyk-mode` (str) How CMYK numbers are chosen for --profiles cmyk (pdf/eps/tiff all use the same engine): 'exact' keeps the profile's values; 'clean' or 'clean:N' snaps every channel to a multiple of N (default 5, so 73/92 becomes 75/90) and prints the colour shift. Greys are always K-only.
- `--cmyk-profile` (file) CMYK ICC profile (e.g. FOGRA39 or your printer's) used for the conversion and embedded as the PDF output intent. Default: Ghostscript's SWOP profile.
- `--recursive` (boolean) When an input is a directory, include SVGs in subdirectories too.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--preset` (str) Name of a [presets.NAME] block to apply, or a built-in preset (favicon, macos-icon).
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview the output file tree without writing anything.
- `--strict` (boolean) Turn CMYK-unsupported-format warnings into hard errors.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--normalize-png / --no-normalize-png` (boolean) Tag PNG output with sRGB via ImageMagick.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite inspect`

Report facts about image/vector files (size, colour mode, transparency, palette, sharpness, GPS...) - for agents and humans.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) Files and/or folders to examine.
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories.
- `--thumb` (path) Write a <=512 px PNG preview of the (single) input, for clients that can look at images.
- `--sheet` (path) Write a labelled contact sheet PNG of all inputs.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite metadata credit`

Embed a signed C2PA provenance manifest (author/copyright) for correct crediting.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more image files, and/or directories (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--author / -a` (str) Author/creator name to embed.
- `--copyright` (str) Copyright notice to embed, e.g. '© 2026 Jane Doe'.
- `--generator` (str, default `mysuite`) Software/tool named as the claim generator (not independently visible in c2patool's own read-back report on all versions — author/copyright are the fields that reliably read back).
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview input -> output pairs, write nothing.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite metadata randomize`

Strip all metadata, then write one internally consistent decoy camera identity (make/model/lens/firmware + plausible exposure and a recent capture time; never GPS).

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more image files, and/or directories (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) List input -> output pairs, write nothing.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite metadata strip`

Strip all EXIF/IPTC/XMP/ICC metadata, writing a new file beside the source.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more image files, and/or directories (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview input -> output pairs, write nothing.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite pipeline run`

Run a pipeline file (TOML or JSON). Steps run in order; each takes the previous step's outputs.

- argument `file` (file, required) Pipeline file (.toml or .json).
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Validate everything and show the plan. Step 1 is planned exactly; later steps that consume earlier outputs are listed symbolically (their file names exist only after the run).
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml, passed to every step.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.

## `mysuite preset list`

List available presets (built-in and from mysuite.toml).

- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.

## `mysuite preset save`

Save export settings as a new (or replacement) preset in mysuite.toml.

- argument `name` (str, required) Preset name.
- `--sizes / -s` (str) Comma-separated sizes, e.g. 16,32,5cm,2in.
- `--formats / -f` (str) Comma-separated formats.
- `--profiles / -p` (str) Comma-separated: rgb,cmyk.
- `--dpi / --ppi` (float) Pixels/dots per inch.
- `--unit` (str) Default unit for bare sizes: px, mm, cm, in.
- `--background` (str) Background color.
- `--quality` (int range) JPEG/WebP quality.
- `--padding / --margin` (str) Uniform margin baseline, e.g. 20px or 10%%.
- `--margin-top` (str) Top margin override.
- `--margin-right` (str) Right margin override.
- `--margin-bottom` (str) Bottom margin override.
- `--margin-left` (str) Left margin override.
- `--png-compression` (int range) PNG compression level.
- `--out / -o` (str) Base output directory.
- `--date-stamp / --no-date-stamp` (boolean) Insert today's date into filenames.
- `--variant` (str) Variant label, e.g. negative, mono.
- `--recolor` (str, repeatable) Exact hex color substitution FROM=TO. Repeatable.
- `--strict / --no-strict` (boolean) 
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) 
- `--normalize-png / --no-normalize-png` (boolean) 
- `--config / -c` (path) TOML file to save into (default: ./mysuite.toml).

## `mysuite schema`

Describe every command's options, the --json result and exit codes (for agents).

- argument `command` (str, repeatable) Limit to one command, e.g. `export` or `metadata strip`.
- `--markdown` (boolean) Print the command reference as Markdown instead of JSON.

## `mysuite tui`

Launch the interactive terminal dashboard.


## `mysuite watermark`

Stamp a logo onto image(s) as a visible, scalable watermark.

- argument `inputs` (path, required, repeatable) One or more image files, and/or directories, to watermark (non-recursive unless --recursive).
- `--logo / -l` (path) Image (or SVG) to stamp onto each input as the watermark.
- `--position / -p` (str, default `bottom-right`) One of: top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center, center-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right.
- `--scale` (float, default `15.0`) Logo width as a percentage of the base image's width.
- `--opacity` (int range, default `80`) Watermark blend opacity, 0-100.
- `--margin` (float, default `3.0`) Breathing room from the edge, as a percentage of the base image's width.
- `--recursive / -r` (boolean) Recurse into subdirectories for folder inputs.
- `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` (boolean) Overwrite existing output files.
- `--dry-run` (boolean) Preview input -> output pairs without watermarking anything.
- `--config / -c` (path) Explicit path to mysuite.toml.
- `--quiet / -q` (boolean) Suppress per-file progress, print summary only.
- `--json` (boolean) Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout (human text goes to stderr). Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 some item failed, 2 bad usage, 3 refused by policy, 4 missing tool.
